title: When constrained minimizers gain symmetry
exact_target: Explain and characterize why constrained action minimizers often have extra symmetries.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002538 (AIM-PHYSICS-0046). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 9.

status_qualification: The source asks for an explanation of a phenomenon and gives examples, without a universal quantifier or precise class of groups. It must not be rewritten as every minimizer has strictly more symmetry. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
